collateral_ratio_scale_basis: every collateral_ratio in this file is a multiple; 1.5135 means 151.35%. Matches the scale published on the snapshot — do not infer it from the field name.
history_coverage: Collateral history starts 2026-09-22, the day the writer was added — NOT the day fxUSD started. No backfill was performed: the per-pool state this ratio is computed from is readable at historical blocks, but deriving it and presenting it beside live rows would mix two granularities in one series without saying so. The peg series (fxusd_peg_history.json) runs from 2025-08-01 and is unaffected.
collateral_ratio_basis: Sigma(raw collateral x the POOL'S OWN oracle anchor) / Sigma(pool debt). The wstETH pool's raw collateral is stETH-equivalent and its oracle prices stETH; multiplying that raw figure by a wstETH market price applies the wrap rate twice and yields ~257% for a pool that reads ~208% (aggregate 155.4% vs 151.2%). riskAnalyst's canonical carried the higher figure as of 2026-09-22 and the question is open with them — recorded here so a later correction reads as a basis change, not as the asset moving.
